title: Legacy of the First Sun
description: A sci-fi survival adventure set on the micro-planet Erebus-9, where a collapsing containment dome threatens the last remnants of life. Explore unstable biomes, survive mutated ecosystems, and unravel the mystery behind the forbidden First Sun Protocol—an experiment that doomed the colony.
features: Mutated wildlife with adaptive AI behaviors
Energy towers that regulate planetary stability
Lore-rich narrative tied to the First Sun Protocol
